messages:
michelle: Heads up — PR 9214 updates the dedicated pool config. This is blocking the late deploy window today; we need two approvals + CI green before sunset (18:00 UTC).

javier: link? I'll skim.

michelle: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/9214 — tiny change to autoscale policy + a comment fix. Failing only on integration-tests-alpha (flaky).

release-bot: CI status for infra#9214: 3/4 checks passing. failing: integration-tests-alpha (flake detected). Use `/retest` to rerun.

aditya: i'll take the review now. will post comments in 10m.

sam: pinging @tara @oliver for quick eyes — this one touches rollout timing.

tara: reading. looks fine at high level. one nit about the comment but not blocking. can approve after aditya's ok.

aditya: nit addressed in a followup commit, pushed. running local smoke, then i'll approve.

michelle: thanks. if integration keeps flaking, plan B = hold to next window and back out the autoscale tweak. want to avoid that.

javier: my calendar is tight but i can give a fast second look in ~25m.

release-bot: CI retry queued by michelle — integration-tests-alpha rerun started.

aditya: LGTM :thumbsup: — behavior matches intent, tests are infra-flaky. approving now.

sam: quick ask: can we merge with `--no-ff` or do you prefer squash?

michelle: keep history, `--no-ff` is fine for infra.

oliver: taking a look now. if green and no objections i'll second approve within 5.

release-bot: CI update: integration-tests-alpha passed on rerun. All checks green.

oliver: OK from me, second approval.

michelle: amazing — two approvals + CI green. i'll merge once you confirm no outstanding async comments.

aditya: no outstanding comments from me.

javier: no blockers from my side.

michelle: merging now: `git merge --no-ff origin/pr/9214` -> merged, opening rolling canary job.

release-bot: Deploy pipeline kicked: canary started for infra-pr-9214. Monitor at https://ci.redwood.com/pipelines/infra/9214/canary

sam: thanks everyone. if canary exposes anything we'll rollback. otherwise this is good for the sunset window. :party_parrot:

michelle: noted — will watch metrics and post an update in #eng-sre in 15m. closing thread.
